10A.
Consider Declaring San Dieguito Water District Property Located at 2315 Cambridge Avenue as Surplus Property. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
District Board take the following actions: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 2017-11 entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Declaring Property Located at 2315 Cambridge Avenue as Surplus Property;" 2) Direct the General Manager to notify the City of Encinitas Planning Commission and other public agencies of the District's intent to dispose of real property; and 3) Subsequent to the review by the other public agencies, if appropriate, in conjunction with the District Board President, set the matter for closed session discussion.
2017-09-20 SDWD Item S10A Declare 2315 Cambridge Ave Surplus Property
10B.
Consider Caltrans Purchase Agreement for a Portion of San Dieguito Water District Property Located Adjacent to Interstate 5. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
District Board take the following actions: 1) Direct the General Manager, in consultation with General Counsel, to negotiate with Caltrans to obtain fair market value for the property; and 2) Direct the General Manager, in consultation with General Counsel, to execute and deliver all legal documents necessary to complete the transaction.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
